chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Walīd narrated from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The woman was only given the value of the wood and the bricks so that she would not marry and bring upon them someone who would corrupt their inheritances.

key_terms.قِيمَةُ الْخَشَبِ وَ الطُّوبِ: The monetary value of wood and bricks in an inheritance ruling
key_terms.لِلْمَرْأَةِ: Refers to the woman as the legal recipient in this ruling

ai.seo_question: Why is a woman given the value of wood and bricks in inheritance rather than the physical materials themselves?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal rationale for assigning a woman the value of structural building materials rather than the materials themselves in an inheritance context. It frames the ruling as a protective measure to prevent an outsider, through marriage, from entering and disrupting the heirs’ inheritance.
